# KickStartYou

> KickStartYou (kickstartyou.org) offers free career support for international students and graduates from the African and Caribbean diaspora in the UK. It looks at two barriers at once: finding an employer that can sponsor a visa, and racial bias in hiring.

KickStartYou was founded by Toluwani Sangosanya. The website kickstartyou.org is its official home. It does not give immigration advice.

## What it offers

- [Roles tracker](https://kickstartyou.org/roles/): UK roles at employers with a Skilled Worker sponsor licence, updated every Monday and Thursday. A sponsor licence means an employer can sponsor, not that every role will.
- [News](https://kickstartyou.org/news/): UK visa and sponsorship news that matters to international students and graduates.
- The Weekly Kick: a free newsletter every Thursday with the roles you can't miss, sponsorship news, and Black food, music and culture events in London, Manchester and Birmingham. Sign up at https://kickstartyou.org/
- [WhatsApp channel](https://whatsapp.com/channel/0029VbEMesjEquiK8Z1TzF3m): standout roles shared as soon as they are found.
